 San Dimas Golf Course Commission Meeting Minutes
October 16, 2025

5.  Golf Course Manager' s Reports

  A.  Mr. Stevens reviewed the GM Update Quarter 3 report ( attached) with the
  following updates:
  New Chef added to team since October 1 st, along with new banquet and golf
  shop staff members.
  Training in high speed to help with the upcoming busy event season of 4 to 6
  events a week.

  Tournament revenue up 3. 5%
  Fall maintenance began and focus is on healing the putting surfaces, tee
  boxes have been aerified, tree root systems through the course and fertilizer
  application completed.
  Mr. Bode stated on the overall success all golf courses have experienced
  during the summer due to the mild weather and it did not affect business for
  the San Dimas Course.

  Mr. Stevens reviewed the Capital Improvement Projects report ( attached) that
  included:

  Ceremony Site is fully functional and will be fully completed once the
  installation of the entry gate.
  Oak tree terrace venue remains for artificial turf, safety railing, and electrical
  along with permits for completion.
  Hole # 9 net project completed.
  Tree lighting at Clubhouse entrance is pending a smaller gage installment for
  completion.

  Model- T is being constructed in South Carolina and will be shipped in
  approximately 4 weeks.
  Tree replacement at # 1 fairway project completed.

  On -Course Restroom and septic tank project is still pending roof, paint and all
  fascia, fixtures replacement, doors and plumbing. Cost still pending final
  review.

  B.  Quarterly Financial Summary Report
  Mr. Stevens read the V Quarter financial report for July through September
  numbers and discussed on the following:

  July 2025 showed the best numbers, with a $ 97, 060 increase from last year
  at that time.

  Golf operations increased along with Food & Beverage  sales.
